subject: Wynfield: hybrid executive workshop — scheduling, travel lanes & buffer windows
messages:

Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Planning: Wynfield exec immersion (hybrid) — dates & logistics

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for taking this on. We’re planning a two-day executive immersion for Wynfield leadership (approx 18–22 attendees in-person + ~30 remote participants) during the week of August 16. Key asks:

- Hybrid design: two plenary sessions (AM) and breakouts (PM) with live remote facilitation.
- AV: dual-camera capture + live captions.
- Travel windows: we have execs flying from London and Berlin — they prefer arriving the evening before.
- Can you propose arrival buffer windows and rehearsal slots for presenters?

Attached is our venue floorplan for context (Wynfield_MAP_venue_floorplan.pdf).

High level questions:
1) Do you have recommended arrival times for senior presenters coming from Europe to San Francisco?
2) What rehearsal buffer would your team suggest for a 40-minute keynote + Q&A?

Appreciate any rough windows today so we can lock travel.

— Marta
Head of Programs | Wynfield Inc
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <mruiz@wynfieldinc.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning: Wynfield exec immersion (hybrid) — dates & logistics

Hi Marta —

Thanks — this looks great and the floorplan is helpful. High-level availability and operational guidance from our side below. I’ve looped Vivek (AV lead) and Laura (travel ops) to cover staging and travel constraints.

Proposed on-site / travel windows (San Francisco venue):
- Presenters arriving from Europe: target arrival by 18:00 local the day before the first session (i.e., arrive Aug 15 by 6pm). That gives ~12–14 hours to recover for AM keynote; doable for most direct flights from London.
- For a 40-min keynote + 15-min live Q&A: we recommend a 90-minute rehearsal block the afternoon prior (60 min full run + 30 min tech check).
- Morning plenaries (hybrid): 09:30–11:30 PT (works for London ~17:30–19:30 BST, Berlin ~18:30–20:30 CEST).
- Afternoon breakouts: 13:30–16:30 PT (remote-friendly).

Buffering and contingency windows:
- AV/Tech dry run: 15:00–16:30 PT on Aug 15 (blocked for presenters + producers).
- Overflow rehearsal / last-minute speaker prep: 07:30–08:45 PT on Aug 16.
- We recommend a 30–60 minute ‘failover’ slot each day in case a session runs long or remote translation glitches occur.

Travel lanes and staging notes:
- Preferred arrival airport: SFO. Shuttle windows: 17:00–19:00 PT (day before) to avoid peak traffic.
- If any execs are connecting from APAC, please flag — we’ll suggest an earlier arrival day.

Attachments I’m including: proposed agenda (Proposed-Agenda_v2.docx) with rehearsal times inserted.

Next steps: can you confirm headcount for in-person speakers and whether any presenters require visa support or ground transport? Once confirmed we’ll lock rehearsal rooms and AV crew.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Solutions Manager

Vanessa / Marta —

Quick operational confirmations from AV/travel ops:
- AV: dual-camera setup + live captions = we’ll allocate a 3-person production crew (director, camera op, A1). Confirm if translation is required; we can add a remote STT + human editor.
- Gear load-in: morning (07:00–09:00 PT) on Aug 16 is tight given vendor rules; prefer load-in evening Aug 15.
- Rehearsal logistics: Vivek to own 90-min rehearsal on Aug 15 15:00–16:30 PT. Please provide slides and any embedded videos 48 hours prior.
- Travel ops (Laura): we’ll circulate preferred hotel blocks near the venue; recommend arrival morning of Aug 15 for APAC, evening Aug 15 for Europe. Shuttle schedule will be shared once we know final headcount.

On internal readiness: I’ll draft a short runbook for the producers and send it by Wed.

- Travel reimbursement: we have a per-diem policy for travel within the US; is Redwood able to process direct ground/shuttle invoices, or should we route reimbursements through Wynfield?
